title: Replacing the root value leaves the comment above it
notes: Edits to a value do not touch comments outside the value (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments), and replacing the document root is an edit of a value, not a removal of its first entry. The comment directly above the first entry stays above the new root. The same replacement after a `---` line keeps the comment before the marker in both backends. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend dropped the comment, the pure backend kept it.
